en: Vintage illustrated postcard with two main vignette images framed by small green leafy branches. The left vignette shows a tall lighthouse tower labeled in French, standing by the sea with surrounding low buildings. The right vignette depicts a busy seafront promenade with colonial-style buildings, people walking, a horse‑drawn carriage, and a monument with a statue in the foreground, with ships and smoke in the harbor background. Printed captions mention Port Said and Queen Victoria's Diamond Jubilee, with handwritten messages over part of the card and a watermark from the website elia.org.gr.
